public_space covers hard plazas, the BM nodes, trunk public edges and neighbourhood squares; vegetated park green is excluded here and counted once in green_ratio.

green_space_area_sqm.formula: sum(polygon_area(green_space)); polygon_area computed in EPSG:4548 (CGCS2000 / 3-degree Gauss-Kruger CM 117E).

corridor_width_m.formula: east_west_extent(submitted_site_boundary); polygon_area computed in EPSG:4548 (CGCS2000 / 3-degree Gauss-Kruger CM 117E).

road_length_m.formula: sum(length(road_centerlines)); polygon_area computed in EPSG:4548 (CGCS2000 / 3-degree Gauss-Kruger CM 117E).
assumptions: Conceptual network: one trunk greenway, five east-west seams and one neighbourhood loop. Not a road red-line or alignment.

site_anchor_argument.formula: Qualitative interpretation: garden-campus layering, Qinghuayuan station and school access, Zhongguancun experimentation, and the named Jing-Zhang key areas.
assumptions: No numerical originality or uniqueness statistic; spatial interpretation must be reworked for another site.

benchmark_anchor_lock.formula: Qualitative cultural-to-spatial reasoning, not a measured count of exclusivity locks.
assumptions: No exclusive origin, global first, or numerical non-portability claim. See the four-root table in the bilingual proposal.
Built by construction: public geometry is differenced against the green geometry before it is written.
